text:
alex.s: quick heads-up — ACME's security team wants a question-by-question bundle for the SIG v3 submission. They called out Q12 (KMS key ownership/rotation), Q23 (data residency), and Q45 (SOC2 evidence). Can security + SEs confirm what we can hand off? Deadline EOD PDT. @maria-sec @devon-se

maria-sec: I can take KMS. We have a KMS architecture diagram, the key rotation policy, and a sanitized rotation audit extract. Links below. Which format does sales want? PDF or CSV?

devon-se: PDF for policies, CSV ok for rotation audit. I'll prepare a redacted CSV with timestamps and principal IDs. Path I'll upload to: s3://redwood-evidence/sig/acme/1956783450/

priya-solutions: I'll grab data residency artifacts — list of active regions, infra diagram showing EU-only deployment, and the DPA excerpt. Will redact account ids.

alex.s: perfect. For SOC2 (Q45) we can provide the SOC2 summary + attestation letter and the SOC2 control matrix export. @maria-sec is there an approved excerpt we can share?

maria-sec: yes — use the "SOC2-Summary-Shareable.pdf" version, it's scrubbed for client release. I'll attach it. Also attaching KMS diagram: "kms-arch-v2.pdf" and rotation policy: "kms-rotation-policy-2025.pdf"

devon-se: uploading rotation audit CSV now (redacted). Filename: kms-rotation-audit-redacted-1956783450.csv. quick preview: 
```
timestamp,principal,action,key_id
2025-02-10T14:03:21Z,redacted,Rotate,kms-abc123
2025-02-11T02:44:09Z,redacted,Rotate,kms-abc123
```

priya-solutions: uploaded EU region list + DPA excerpt to the same bucket. Filenames: "acme-eu-regions-2025.csv", "dpa-excerpt-acme-2025.pdf"

alex.s: can someone zip everything under the canonical filename: ACME_SIG_v3_1956783450.zip and upload to the Sales SharePoint? Customer asked for a single download link.

devon-se: will do. I'll assemble the zip, run checksum, and post link here. ETA ~20m. :thumbsup:

[evidence-bot]: upload complete — s3://redwood-evidence/sig/acme/1956783450/ACME_SIG_v3_1956783450.zip (md5: 9a7b3f2d8c4e5f2b6d1f0a7c3b4e5d6a)

alex.s: nailed it, thanks team. I'll share the link with ACME and note the files we redacted. If they push for raw logs we'll ask for an NDA addendum.

maria-sec: good call. ping me if they request unredacted principals — need legal sign-off.

devon-se: done on the SharePoint pointer and pasted link in the CRM ticket. Closing thread.
